lesson_title: The Supermarket vs the Fruit Stand Outside It
hook_text: A huge supermarket and a tiny fruit stand sell the same apples on the same corner. Who wins?
clip_script: The supermarket: registered with CIPC and SARS, pays tax, fifty staff on UIF, bank loans for a new branch. That is a formal business. Outside the door, Mr Sithole: a table, R500 of fruit, cash only, no registration. That is an informal business. He can move to the taxi rank when it's busy, but he can't get a loan, and some days he gets moved on. So who wins? Both, because both meet a need. Taxi passengers want a quick, cheap apple. Shoppers want choice and a roof. Every business, big or small, starts with a need someone will pay for.
visual_style: A whiteboard street corner with a big supermarket building and a small fruit table outside, labelled formal and informal with pros and cons.
mood: Curious and fair, big versus small.
pacing: Quick side-by-side comparison, then a calm needs-and-wants message.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and list three informal businesses near your home and the need each one meets.
